1. **Shape.** Draft PR against `main`; body first line `Fixes #23662`, then `Clause-②: no` at line start, copied from claim 6191722854. The only closing keyword is that one; #23653 is named with no verb beside it. The file list is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md` alone (+2/−2), the claimed surface; `SKILL.md` is untouched, and its four-axis block md5 is unchanged per the dev.
2. **Premises and the text, read by the seat on `origin/main` against the diff.**
   - L33 now ends 「翻字母只凭维护者卡上另裁,唯④新增门禁例外」 and L34 ends 「答是不改字母,唯④新增门禁例外」. Both name axis ④'s 「新增门禁默认否 … 否则荐「不加」」 as the one exception, which is the seat's first shape (dispatch 6191775847).
   - L32 keeps the general rule, and the exception follows on the next line.
   - The cut clause 「工作量恒逐选项列」 still has two homes: L25 (「选项 × 真实代价 × 工作量表:每选项一行,… + 工作量」) and `SKILL.md` L269 (「决策卡带选项、推荐、证据、四棱块与工作量列」). No rule is lost.
   - Net 0 lines, with the `CEILINGS` row unmoved (50).
3. **Gates — check-runs pinned to head `3eccd21a7a`.** 36 check-runs: 20 `success`, 12 `skipped`, 4 `in_progress` (`Type Check · consumer gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`). The dev's local union at `3eccd21a7` covers 17 derived families, all 17 run at exit 0, `--ran` with 0 unrun. The pre-landing check re-reads every check-run on the head of the day.
4. **Deviations accepted.**
   - The suggested L34 extension measured 184 B, over the 120 B per-line cap, and no lossless whole-line deletion existed. The text is therefore said in place: L33 pays its added bytes with the redundant clause above, and L34 uses its own slack.
   - The branch merged `origin/main` once (`547702080`) on a STALE TREE flag before opening.
5. **Out of scope.**
   - Findings filed: none.
   - The dev's Acceptance note is `dropped — not a card` under the filing gate's protocol-observation class. `SKILL.md` L265 (「…四轴冲突时其余各轴合起来投不翻它。」) also names no axis-④ exception; the dev reads L266 as reconciling it. Carrier: this seat's shift brief, principle class, for the skills seat's own topic list.
6. **Landing.**
   - **At-tier contract review: OWED.** The face is `references/decision-analysis.md`, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The reviewer launched on this head stopped on that tier's usage limit (HTTP 429, reported by 2026-10-15T12:41Z), the second such refusal this shift, and wrote no record. `needs:contract-review` stays on this PR until a PASS on its head is on file.
   - After that, the pre-landing checks (all check-runs green, `check-governed-merges --pr 23675` Tier S), then `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3eccd21a7adace9d4adbb0b4542fea19532b4c4d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

Face: rules — a governed path, the register's Tier S `claude-tree` row. Inputs read, and nothing else: the card body and its five comments (6191489186 triage, 6191722854 claim, 6191775847 dispatch, 6192267305 os-dev-report, 6192351736 ACCEPT); the PR body and file list (one file, +2/−2); the net diff against the merge-base `547702080`, identical to the three-dot diff from `origin/main`; `decision-analysis.md` whole at main and at head; `SKILL.md` at head (byte-identical to `origin/main`); the ratchet's CEILINGS rows and SKILL.md L291; commit `5e231a08b`; the 42 check-runs on the head. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The flip set widens by exactly one named clause and the recommend set narrows — right.** Before: only 「翻字母只凭维护者卡上另裁」 (L33) may flip ①'s letter, and the self-check's 「是」 never does (L34). After: both lines end 「,唯④新增门禁例外」. The template's L3 defers the four-axis frame to `SKILL.md`, and 优先级 (SKILL.md L42) ranks 细则 below the frame's own text, so the template yielding to axis ④'s 「新增门禁默认否…荐新增门禁须引其点名原话,否则荐「不加」」 (SKILL.md L254–255) is the only direction that fixes the card. The outcome is the one the tie-break L45 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡」 already produced on #23653: the letter becomes 「不加」. No new permission is created — the exception points at a clause that is itself default-no.
2. **The pointer 「④新增门禁」 resolves to one source — right.** Template L45 numbers ④ as 创业阶段不扩散, the same axis `SKILL.md` lists fourth, whose bold clause is 「新增门禁默认否」; that clause already carries the condition (no maintainer naming quote) and the outcome (「不加」). The template restates neither, so no second copy of the frame appears — the thing `check:skill-frame-sync` watches `references/` for. Both readings of the terse phrase (the clause's name, or the situation it governs) land on the same case.
3. **L32 left absolute — right, and measured.** L32 is 113 B; the shortest qualifier 「,唯④新增门禁例外」 is 25 B (an ASCII comma and eight 3-byte characters); 138 B exceeds the 120 B cap, and the only in-line deletion available is L32's own 「⛔ 不翻字母」, which carries the marker. L33 is the line that says WHO may flip, so the exception belongs there; L32 stays the general rule with its one exception on the next line.
4. **Payment is a real deletion that loses no rule — right.** 「工作量恒逐选项列;」 (25 B) leaves L33. L25 already requires a 工作量 cell on every option row (「每选项一行,做什么 + 客户可感知后果 + 工作量」), L26 defines the column, and SKILL.md L269 requires 「工作量列」 on every decision card. Commit `5e231a08b` (#22654) introduced L25's column and this clause in the same hunk, so the clause was a restatement from birth. The deletion also satisfies the CEILINGS row's own convention for this file (no rule already stated in SKILL.md). Nothing was re-wrapped: L21–L22 and L25 are byte-identical before and after.
5. **Ratchet readings hold — right.** Measured on the committed trees: 50 → 50 lines; CEILINGS row 50 unmoved (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` L570); widest-table-row pin 0 untouched (L2046); file 3,488 → 3,513 B; L33 120 → 120 B; L34 94 → 119 B; widest line 120 B (L16) before and after; zero lines over the cap. SKILL.md L291 (⛔ re-wrap 不得用作筹行,新增以删减付账) is obeyed. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, the job that carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, is success on the head.
6. **No gate co-changes with the rule — right.** The text is agent-facing (SKILL.md L258–259: 「声明即强制」只及 spec 与元数据契约、运行时能力,⛔ 不及 … 给 agent 读的约定), so no enforcing gate exists to move, and none should.
7. **Public surface: none — right.** No package, export, schema or route is in the diff; `.claude/**` ships in no npm tarball.
8. **Governance handled as Tier S — right.** Head repo equals base repo; the PR is draft, `auto_merge` null, labelled `needs:contract-review`; no approving review exists; SKILL.md is untouched (four-axis block L241–261 md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0` at head, equal to the dispatch's reading); nothing under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` moved on `main` between the merge-base and `origin/main`, so no jointly-wrong merge is possible on this surface.
9. **Repo prose rules — right.** Title and body in English with the Chinese rulings quoted verbatim; the rule lines carry no tracker number (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` green); both commits end with the model-free trailer pair; no model identifier anywhere in the PR.

Check-runs on the head: 42 runs, zero failures, zero in progress. The five required contexts: `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Test Core` success, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `Build Core` skipped — by the filter contract (`ci.yml`'s `build-core` runs unless `filter.outputs.core` is `false`; `filter` is success, and a `.claude/**`-only diff makes it false), the designed answer for this path class, not an absent pass. Every other run is success or filter-skipped.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no`, no arm — well-formed. The diff publishes nothing from any released package, so no changeset is owed and the `skip-changeset` label is the correct declaration; `Check Changeset` is success on the head. No ADR-0087 disposition applies: nothing breaking, nothing authorable removed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `open_questions`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: none. `premise_still_valid: true` — confirmed: the dispatch's three mechanism assumptions, (a) 50/50 lines with L32/L33/L34 at 113/120/94 B, (b) net 0 lines with no CEILINGS move, (c) SKILL.md's axis ④ text unchanged, all hold on the committed trees.
- Acceptance note — SKILL.md L265 「长远合理性权重恒 ≥50%:…四轴冲突时其余各轴合起来投不翻它」 names no exception — **answered: not a blocker, and no card is owed by this PR.** The weight floor and axis ④'s default-no clause have coexisted in SKILL.md since both landed; this PR neither creates nor widens that pairing. L266 「权重只排推荐不授权:…⛔ 不背书投机扩张、不放行人工地板事」 is the reading under which they agree, and it is the same reading the ratchet's row history records for the weight floor (its two guards exist so it cannot underwrite speculative expansion and cannot move the human floor). A gate the maintainer never named is exactly what the weight does not authorise. If the skills seat wants L265 to say so in its own words, that is a one-line SKILL.md card after PR #23668 lands — outside this PR's file surface by the dispatch's ⛔.
- Acceptance note — one merge of `origin/main` before the PR opened (STALE TREE on the ratchet script) — informational; the three-dot diff is the one file, and the script's change on main touched none of this file's rows.
- Dispatch's shape choice (the first shape, not the 禁止行 move) — right: the second shape edits the maintainer's frame block, pasted verbatim into every dispatch and kept in sync by `check:skill-frame-sync`, whose SKILL.md neighbour is in flight with seat 1.
- Nothing to escalate.
